name: Copernicus Browser
description: Browse, compare, and download Sentinel, Landsat, and other open imagery in the browser, with band combinations and time-lapse. The friendliest open imagery browser, though some functions need a free login.
embedNote: No frame-blocking header seen; preview loads in an iframe

Software Licensing.note: Based on the open EO Browser; hosted build not published

Data Licensing.note: Copernicus Sentinel data are free and open

Technical Accessibility.note: Web app with downloads; some functions need a free account

Data Standards.note: Cloud-optimised GeoTIFF and standard EO formats

Infrastructure.note: Hosted by the Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem; data mirrored elsewhere
